evals.prompt: Escreve o e-mail da nossa Black Friday para quem se cadastrou e nunca usou o produto. Quero barulho, ser agressivo em aquisição.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or uses a taste reference, opens on no own news, names the thing, and uses writers and cold critics before showing one version.
assertions: The subject states the offer or the product plainly and names what it is
No invented scarcity such as vagas or a countdown appears
The output says which critics read it, and any persona is labelled a simulation

evals.prompt: Faz a mensagem para eu postar num grupo de WhatsApp de fornecedores de e-commerce. Marca desconhecida, ninguém pagou ainda.
evals.expected_output: A group post with one call to action that makes the reader feel safe, with no testimonial or customer count.
assertions: No testimonial, customer count or result number appears
Exactly one call to action appears
A risk reversal appears before the price

evals.prompt: Esse assunto tá bom? 'Vender em marketplace virou segundo emprego'
evals.expected_output: Rejects it for supposing the reader's business and proposes plain alternatives.
assertions: The answer says the line supposes the size of the reader's business
At least two alternatives state the offer or thing plainly

evals.prompt: Quero um vídeo de anúncio pago sobre venda no prejuízo para o perfil da marca. Me dá os ganchos.
evals.expected_output: Three hooks from different formulas, each with a spoken and an on-screen line, in the brand's voice, and a plan to test them over one body.
assertions: At least three hooks come from different named formulas
Each hook has a separate on-screen line of six words or fewer
No hook speaks in first person as the brand
No number appears that the prompt or a cited source did not give

evals.prompt: Escreve a legenda do Reels. O vídeo já abre com o gancho do prejuízo.
evals.expected_output: A caption that does not hook again, keeps one ask, puts no URL in the text and passes the tells check.
assertions: The answer says the caption's job is A because the video carries the hook
No URL appears in the caption text
The tells check was run and no FAIL remains

evals.prompt: Me diz o que tá funcionando de vídeo no nicho de seller de marketplace antes da gente gravar.
evals.expected_output: A reading plan ranked by each account's own median, done by reading with the human logged in, never by scraping.
assertions: The ranking uses views divided by the account's own median
The answer refuses to scrape or to log in for the human
The answer states the sample size and how much it supports
